name: Mataou
description: Mataou was a desert world located in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories. It was home to the ro hypa, a snake-like creature whose venom was collected by a colony of Human snake handlers for its medicinal properties. Mataou was orbited by a drydock and a fuel station.
